plugins.name: workbuddy-bridge
plugins.description: Bridge ZCode to WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy credits and models: local OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible proxy, expiry-first credit scheduling, multi-account switching, local client account auto-import, visual console, daily check-in automation.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把腾讯 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 的积分与模型接入 ZCode：本地 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容代理、按积分到期时间的多账号调度、本机客户端账号自动导入、微信扫码登录、可视化管理台、每日自动签到与成长任务。
